01 · Meet the client

singapore's modern toy factory

Mox Monsters is a Singapore toy studio and small-batch factory. It sculpts, prints, moulds, casts, paints and packs collectibles under one roof, for brands that want merchandise people keep, and for its own original characters.

one roof

From first sketch to final pack, made in Singapore with no middlemen.

1 → 10,000

Small runs made affordable, from one-off passion projects to full production.

two sides

Custom collectibles and mascots for brands, plus Mox Monsters' own characters.

05 · The bigger idea

a toy factory experience for children who need it most

Mox Monsters already hosts children at the factory, including a young regular visitor who comes almost every week. Looking ahead, Kenneth wants to extend this experience to less fortunate children, working with partner organisations.

This is Mox Monsters' corporate social responsibility (CSR) angle: using what the factory does best to bring joy, creativity and a sense of making to children.

A first 3D-printed boat, made at the factory
